risks.risk: Camera may be non-functional or have internal damage (e.g., sensor, shutter, or electronics)
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, menu navigation, and taking a photo, or a close-up of the sensor and shutter mechanism.

risks.risk: Lens may be damaged or non-functional (e.g., cracked glass, misaligned elements, or missing parts)
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lens glass, especially the front and rear elements, and a video showing the lens focusing and aperture changing.

risks.risk: Camera may have been tampered with or have a non-original battery or charger
risks.proof: A photo of the battery and charger, and a video showing the battery charging and the camera powering on.
risks.if_unproven: priced as missing battery or charger

risks.risk: Camera may have been used in harsh conditions (e.g., water, dust, or extreme temperatures) affecting performance
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the camera body and lens showing signs of wear, scratches, or residue.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used with potential wear

proof_requests: Video showing the camera powering on, navigating menus, and taking a photo.
Close-up photo of the lens glass, especially the front and rear elements.
Photo of the battery and charger, and a video showing the battery charging and the camera powering on.
Close-up photo of the camera body and lens showing signs of wear or damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
